literal_meaning: সাতটি কথা শোনানো (seven words to make hear)
figurative_meaning_en: To say many harsh or bitter words (scolding severely)
similar_in_english: Give someone a piece of one's mind
example_sentences_in_bangla: মা ছেলেকে সাত কথা শোনাচ্ছে কারণ সে দেরি করে এসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The mother is giving her son an earful for coming home late.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali conversational style, emphasizing verbal admonishment.
